headline: CSL Finance Limited Takeover Disclosure
sum: **CSL Finance Limited filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4)** regarding a substantial acquisition of shares, indicating a takeover or significant stake acquisition event.
implication: Regulation 31(4) triggers when acquirer(s) cross 25% threshold (or intend to cross 75%); this disclosure is a mandatory gating item before any open offer mechanics can proceed, and establishes the acquirer's identity and intent in the public record.
detail: The company submitted to NSE a formal disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This regulation requires disclosure when any person acquires (or intends to acquire) 25% or more of voting capital. The filing triggers subsequent open offer obligations and public scrutiny. Specific acquirer, stake percentage, and consideration details are not available in public corroborating sources.
